objective: written onset | written final under literal ordinary-initial D=0; CKT v5.1 primary

memoryDefinition.note: A final exception is one complete written-final family moved away from the seven-rule base; physical key and column permutations are not counted as exceptions.

search.algorithm: deterministic simulated annealing proxy -> sampled CKT rerank -> full CKT
